info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Business Control Business Unit Management-spec
info.description: The Business Unit Management API facilitates the creation and management of business units within the financial services sector. This API enables organizations to define various business units, allowing for better control and organization of operations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and business administrators who need to streamline their business structures. By offering efficient management tools, this API supports improved alignment of business strategies with operational capabilities.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new business unit within the business control system. It accepts the necessary data in the request body to define the business unit's attributes and configurations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update a business unit within the business control management system. The data must comply with the defined schema to ensure proper processing and validation.
